prices.source: World Bank, Remittance Prices Worldwide, rpw_dataset_2011_2025_q3.xlsx (sheet "Dataset (from Q2 2016)"), column "cc1 total cost %" (sending the equivalent of US$200)

volumes.source: Center for Global Development, updated 2024 bilateral remittances matrix (Huckstep & Clemens, 2026), "Bilateral remittances (current US$)", year 2024
volumes.note: Modelled estimates, not observed transactions (the authors' caveat).

quotes.source: NEAR Intents 1Click API, POST https://1click.chaindefuser.com/v0/quote with dry: true (no funds move)

p2p.source: Binance P2P public ad search (median of the top 5 USDT ads per side)
